production.note: US model years. First: Audi of America's release announcing pricing for "the all-new 2017 R8". Last: Kelley Blue Book (a database) lists R8 model years 2017, 2018 and then 2020, with no 2019 (kbb-r8-years); its 2017 and 2018 pages list the V10 plus Coupe (kbb-r8-2017-plus, kbb-r8-2018-specs). The 2020 facelift's V10 performance is a different variant.

body.note: The open R8 Spyder is sold under its own name and is not part of this record.

displacementL.note: 5,204 cc per carsales.com.au (a database, 2017 R8 V10 Plus): "5204 cc" (carsales-r8-2017-plus). Audi: "5.2-liter V10 FSI". Car and Driver's panel: "318 in3, 5204 cm3" (cd-r8-v10-plus-2017).

aspiration.note: Inferred: a 5.2-liter V10 FSI with no forced induction.

transmission.note: "seven-speed S tronic" dual-clutch; no manual was offered on this generation.

powerHp.note: Quote (Audi of America release, specification table): "R8 V10 plus | 5.2-liter V10 FSI | seven-speed S tronic with quattro AWD | 610 hp @ 8,250 - 8,700 rpm". KBB's 2017 page agrees: "Horsepower | 610 @ 8250 RPM" (kbb-r8-2017-plus). KBB's 2018 specifications page shows "602 @ 8250 RPM" for the V10 plus Coupe (kbb-r8-2018-specs), not explained by any Audi page opened; the 2017 rating is used. KBB's 602 hp for 2018 is Audi's 610 PS converted (x 0.98632); Audi's US '610 hp' is numerically the PS figure and is used as published, as for the 918 Spyder. Car and Driver's road-test panel for the 2017 car prints the same rating: "Power" / "610 hp @ 8250 rpm" (cd-r8-v10-plus-2017).

weightLb.note: Weight-order step 2: Car and Driver road-test curb weight (owner decision, 9 October 2026, docs/DATA_GUIDE.md); a measured weight of C/D's test car. Car and Driver road-test panel '2017 Audi R8 V10 Plus' (owner copy), quote: "Curb weight: 3684 lb". Test car: "mid-engine, 4-wheel-drive, 2-passenger, 2-door coupe", "7-speed dual-clutch automatic with manual shifting mode" (the only transmission), "$202,750 (base price: $192,450)" as tested; no options are listed. The earlier provisional figure, 3,572 lb (AutoGuide, Jonathan Yarkony; KBB, a database), is 3.0% lower; see discrepancies.

discrepancies.reason: Car and Driver's figure is the measured weight of its test car. AutoGuide and KBB give 3,572 lb labelled curb weight (3.0% lower). duPont Registry's "3,205.5 pounds" for the 2018 coupe is not labelled curb or dry and is about 13% below C/D; it is probably Audi's European dry weight, which no Audi page opened confirms.
discrepancies.resolution: Owner decision, 9 October 2026: the Car and Driver road-test curb weight is used (docs/DATA_GUIDE.md, Weight step 2). 3,684 lb used; the earlier 3,572 lb was the provisional figure.
